shots.title: A month declared lost
shots.action: Marcus raises the creased calendar, then recoils at its blank square; paper and eyebrows react on failure.
shots.words: Marcus missed one workout and declared the whole month a failure.

shots.title: The evening ritual
shots.action: Marcus finishes a short traveling exercise loop, stops and colours a square with a marker touching the held calendar.
shots.words: Every evening, he trained, coloured one square green, and admired his perfect calendar.

shots.title: Protecting the squares
shots.action: Marcus hugs the calendar closer, checks it sternly, and turns his body away from the inviting path.
shots.words: Soon, protecting the streak became more important than enjoying the routine.

shots.title: The lane floods
shots.action: Rain crosses the lit 3D courtyard, puddles ripple, and Marcus backs toward shelter as thunder starts.
shots.words: Then a storm flooded the lane.

shots.title: One blank square
shots.action: The paper rocks on its stand; a hand indicates the single blank square without covering the surrounding greens.
shots.props: physical calendar, supporting stand, visible hand

shots.title: Toward the bin
shots.action: Marcus walks toward the bin carrying the rolled tracker in one hand and his training shoes by their joined laces in the other.
shots.words: Marcus rolled up the calendar and marched his shoes toward the bin.

shots.title: The neighbour's wall
shots.action: Marcus approaches; the older builder carries a brick toward the unfinished top course.
shots.props: held brick, low wall, mortar tray, bucket
shots.words: Luckily, his neighbour was building a wall.

shots.title: An unsolicited brick lecture
shots.action: Marcus gestures with the rolled calendar while the builder raises an eyebrow and keeps the brick in a visible hand.
shots.words: Unluckily, Marcus was about to explain bricks to a bricklayer.

shots.title: The bricks remain
shots.action: Marcus points toward the empty end of the top course. The builder looks at the gap and then sweeps a free hand across the solid completed courses.
shots.props: supported brick courses, empty top slot, held brick
shots.words: He pointed at one empty space. The neighbour looked at the gap, then at all the bricks still standing.

shots.title: Repetition in context
shots.action: The builder travels past the same bench with another brick; a paper calendar, book and familiar tools establish repetition in one setting.
shots.words: You see, habits develop through repetition in a familiar situation.

shots.title: A limited study finding
shots.action: A magnifier moves across a physical tracker; its one blank and many completed cells remain visible alongside a bound notebook. The scene illustrates the study rather than inventing data.
shots.props: tracker, moving magnifier, bound notebook, cup
shots.words: In one study of everyday habits, missing a single opportunity did not materially disrupt the process.

shots.title: Adding a brick
shots.action: A visible hand lowers one brick onto the supported top course and releases it. The camera follows its short descent; dust marks contact and the earlier bricks stay put.
shots.props: brick, hand, mini wall, separate next brick
shots.words: Think of adding bricks. Skipping one delivery doesn't make yesterday's wall disappear.

shots.title: A site left idle
shots.action: The builder walks away from the bench. The wall and loose next brick remain; the unfinished top course does not grow.
shots.props: solid mini wall, untouched next brick, tools
shots.words: But abandoning the building site certainly stops it getting taller.

shots.title: Shoes at the same doorway
shots.action: A sleeve and hand lower the paired trainers onto the same mat, release the joined laces, then withdraw.
shots.words: So the next evening, Marcus put his shoes beside the same doorway

shots.title: The next sensible step
shots.action: Marcus walks a relaxed new loop, with a small hand gesture rejecting a doubled effort and a planted next step on the final word.
shots.words: and returned to his usual routine. No heroic double session. Just the next sensible step.

shots.title: A gap and seven later squares
shots.action: The physical calendar adds seven later green squares while its original blank stays blank. A slow elevated camera move reveals the whole supported tracker and table.
shots.words: A week later, his calendar still had a gap. It also had seven new green squares.

shots.title: The calendar lies flat
shots.action: The tracker unrolls and settles across the table. A hand brings the brick above it, ready to keep the paper flat.
shots.props: unrolling calendar, visible hand, held brick
shots.words: This time, Marcus used a brick to hold the calendar flat.

shots.title: Progress needs a paperweight
shots.action: The hand releases the brick onto the corner on paperweight. The imperfect tracker stays flat as the hand withdraws and the camera finishes on the last word.
shots.props: brick, calendar with one blank and seven later greens, hand
shots.words: Apparently, progress needed a paperweight more than a perfect record.
